q1_issues.issue: The distributive "make" predication is emitted only as the per-member Implication; the Cardinality rule for a vague-count plural with a distributive predicate keeps the group event alongside the rule, and no group-level make event is present.

(CardinalityPhrase sk_group_1 "handful") records "handful" while both the surface phrase and the lexicon list in Cardinality write "a handful", so the string may not match the canonical lexicon entry the seeded rules key on.

q2_gaps: A restrictive relative clause on a group NP ("a handful of companies THAT still make the flu vaccine"): nothing says whether the relative clause becomes a per-member Implication over the group, a group-level event, or rule premises - the only relative-clause guidance is donkey anaphora, which puts a relative clause in a rule's PREMISES.

"one of a handful of N" - a partitive whose superset is INDEFINITE; Partitives is explicitly scoped to "of the / of these / of those / of them" over a definite presupposed set, so the superset group here is introduced without a licensing rule.
notes: Routing "based in Strasbourg" to (LocatedIn aventis strasbourg) rather than a reduced-relative event is right, since its expansion is a bare position clause, which mints no event whatever its verb; "Strasbourg, France" correctly takes LocatedIn rather than PartOf. Putting Still inside the rule consequent rather than outside is also correct.
